## About This Application

Machine Usage Tracking is a web application that monitors and displays how often machines and when machines are being used. We use microcontroller with sensors attached that report when they turn ON or OFF. The dashboard shows a calendar view of daily machine usage, and users can click any day to see a detailed timeline of when each machine was active.

**Key Features:**
- Real-time machine monitoring via microcontrollers and sensors
- Monthly calendar view detailing machine usage
- Daily timeline view with exact session times
- User registration and account management
- Admin panel for managing machines and users
